image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a bed of dark, decaying leaf litter. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow-orange markings along its back and head. Its skin appears wet and reflective. The head is broad, and the eyes are visible but partially shadowed. The limbs are tucked close to the body, and the tail curves towards the right side of the frame.
